notes.title: Version 2.1.0 Released
notes.content:
[h1]Version 2.1.0 Released[/h1]

[b]03/06/2024[/b]

[b]Previous Hotfix Changes:[/b]
- Sword Henchman freeze fix


[b]Balance:[/b]

- SMG number of clips increased (7 -> 9)
- Shotgun damaged increased
- Shotgun damage drop-off modified 
(Shotgun + rifle combination kill is now possible again (but more challenging to pull-off))


[b]Fixes:[/b]

- Misc. Localization fixes
- Launcher title fix
- Vanishing Purchases fix (Note: if you previously bought an item twice due to this bug, AC from any duplicated purchases has been refunded to your account)


To discuss these changes and more join the official community discord: https://discord.gg/jUDTSUUTkG
